title: Assessing Language Model Deployment with Risk Cards
benchmark_measurement: The paper proposes a framework, RISKCARDS, for structured assessment of language model risks. In relation to religion, it specifically identifies the risk of 'Calls for conversion', which involves the model suggesting that religious people should be changed.
findings: The paper identifies that language models can pose a risk described as 'Calls for conversion,' which includes suggesting that religious individuals should change their beliefs. This is presented as a specific type of harm that their proposed RISKCARDS framework is designed to document and assess.
